protocol.liability_reference: clean source tables isolated under each split/reference/
protocol.issue_scoring: mapped injected error types and source row identifiers
protocol.matching_baseline: exact normalized invoice number and amount only

anomaly_approval_threshold.cause: The amount rule is conservative, while the broader vendor and Isolation Forest signals add unrelated anomaly candidates.

anomaly_round_number.cause: Round-number detection is suppressed for vendors whose history already contains many round totals.

anomaly_unusual_spike.cause: The robust-z and Isolation Forest signals are broad and miss spikes when vendor history is sparse or skewed.

new_vendor_huge_invoice.cause: The detector depends on the source `is_new_vendor` flag and configured threshold matching the injected high invoice.

payment_before_invoice.cause: Detection depends on a bank candidate surviving invoice/reference blocking; unmatched references are not date-compared.

invalid_gstin.cause: Test B GSTIN values follow different conventions; the strict 15-character/checksum rule is intentionally reported separately.

vendor_name_variant.cause: The mismatch rule targets invoice-to-filing names; equivalent company suffix/case variants are normalized and may not be surfaced.

wrong_tax_split.cause: Test B uses legacy conventions that differ from the Maharashtra CGST/SGST-versus-IGST rule.

weakest_error_types.cause: The mismatch rule targets invoice-to-filing names; equivalent company suffix/case variants are normalized and may not be surfaced.
